purpose: Bounded convergence consultation after complete raw generation; a primary indexing of overlapping computational moves, not an efficacy, novelty or feasibility verdict.
consultation_boundary: Shared tools and filesystem; not independent review.
primary_assignment_rule: Every raw entry occurs in exactly one primary cluster. Secondary conceptual overlap is recorded separately and does not alter the primary map.
independent_mechanism_count: not established; neither 72 entries nor 15 clusters denotes independent mechanisms

clusters.name: Retain alternative interpretations
clusters.underlying_move: Keep several still-compatible explanations or readings without forcing a single commitment.

clusters.name: Construct the description language
clusters.underlying_move: Discover variables, predicates, identities or relations that the previous description could not distinguish.

clusters.name: Bound and revise rule applicability
clusters.underlying_move: Attach exceptions, substitution boundaries, evidence-type bridges or context guards to a generalization.

clusters.name: Preserve relations across description changes
clusters.underlying_move: Impose or discover equivalence across names, encodings or calibrations.

clusters.name: Change what representation selection rewards
clusters.underlying_move: Allocate compression or representational support by decision distinctions, reliability or otherwise-unexplained errors.

clusters.name: Identify the observation process
clusters.underlying_move: Record or manipulate the conditions of observation to distinguish changes in the world from changes in access or measurement.

clusters.name: Preserve or restore opportunities for evidence
clusters.underlying_move: Keep access to, return to, or reopen conditions in which an unresolved distinction could be observed.

clusters.name: Choose actions by the questions they distinguish
clusters.underlying_move: Use disagreements or a declared future-question family to allocate experiments or decide whether to continue inquiry.

clusters.name: Broaden interaction coverage
clusters.underlying_move: Obtain varied observation opportunities through enumeration, coverage weighting, alternative goals or different policies.

clusters.name: Learn whether inquiry obtained its promised evidence
clusters.underlying_move: Compare predicted experiment informativeness with what the resulting observations actually separated.

clusters.name: Separate or duplicate history-bearing states
clusters.underlying_move: Avoid a single shared evolving state through cases, context separation, freezing, redundant encodings or conditional splitting.

clusters.name: Maintain compatibility between changing internal interfaces
clusters.underlying_move: Track or constrain the mapping between a learned representation and a response interface while either side changes.

clusters.name: Diagnose or reconstruct access to surviving state
clusters.underlying_move: Use constraints, probes, update histories or structural matching to assess and build a readout.

clusters.name: Make reading or updating undoable
clusters.underlying_move: Use inversion or a disposable copy so access attempts can revisit a state or avoid modifying the acting state.

clusters.name: Use continuing interaction or external arrangements for later access
clusters.underlying_move: Renew the relevant encounter, build a new access route, preserve an external cue or retain a reacquisition procedure.

tentative_move_assessment.controlled_object: live explanation/state pairs within a supplied finite transducer family
tentative_move_assessment.distinctness_condition: Retains compatible alternatives under fixed evidence and acquisition; does not enlarge the hypothesis language.
tentative_move_assessment.dependency: Can supply alternatives to C2, but C1 is separately compared under a fixed acquisition policy.

tentative_move_assessment.controlled_object: the next bounded experiment policy and its resulting observations
tentative_move_assessment.distinctness_condition: Uses an externally fixed predictive and inference substrate; selects by expected later decision loss after world change and cost.
tentative_move_assessment.dependency: Restoration is an allowed experiment if included and modelled; this operation does not itself learn a restoration procedure or predictive family.

tentative_move_assessment.controlled_object: the linear correspondence between current features and reference activations
tentative_move_assessment.distinctness_condition: Encoder training and old readout remain fixed while the map is fitted using declared anchors and reference activations.
tentative_move_assessment.dependency: Reference activations are a surviving history-bearing channel; held-out access and latent survival remain separate questions.

tentative_move_assessment.controlled_object: a conditional boundary for a supplied target F within a supplied finite atom library
tentative_move_assessment.distinctness_condition: Retains witnesses and enumerates a scope; does not create predicates or expand the language within an instance.
tentative_move_assessment.dependency: Raw B1-14 motivated an upstream request, not an implemented predicate learner. C4 is related to C1 through consistency but selects a local scope rather than retaining all compatible explanatory states.

verdict: No selection, efficacy, novelty or feasibility verdict issued. PI retains selection judgment.
consultation_correction: Initial raw-anchor assessment called the fourth tentative move a composite including predicate discovery. Developed C4 explicitly excludes that operation; witness retention and boundary enumeration now form one defined scope operation. Raw clustering is unchanged.
